description.en:
The general routine behind the RemoveParty_Message and RemovePartyNum_Message helpers: removes one or more characters from the party, each with a sound effect and a system message.
If _fade is 0 or more, the current BGM is stopped with that fade and the function waits until it has stopped. It then waits _wait frames.
For each character: the sound effect number _jingle (CMND_SND_OPEN_SYS_SE) is played if it exists, the message placeholder 0 is set to the character, the message _event is shown with CreateSpeech, and the character is removed. With _not_pt_lock true it uses RemovePartyCmnd(id, reset, false), otherwise RemoveParty(id, reset). The function waits for the sound to finish before the next character.
At the end, if _fade is 0 or more, the BGM plays again with that fade and the function waits _fade frames.
Number of characters to remove (read from index 0 of the arrays).
Parameter IDs of the characters to remove.
Fade used to stop and restart the BGM; -1 leaves it alone. The presets pass 30 or 0.
Frames to wait before the first character (the presets pass 45 or 0).
System sound effect number (the presets pass 21, sys_021).
Message shown for each character (the presets pass "sysmes-remove_party").
true to call RemovePartyCmnd(id, reset, false) instead of RemoveParty(id, reset); see RemoveParty for the difference.
